about: SPEC 4.5. The source data only says "shoulders"; the drawing has front and rear delt shapes. Every catalog exercise that lists shoulders says here which part it means: front, rear, side (drawn on the front delt shape, text says side delts), rotator cuff (text only), or leave out when the shoulders only steady the weight. labels replaces the text for one muscle when the exercise is more specific than the source (upper chest on an incline). Checked by src/lib/__tests__/muscles.test.ts.

Ab_Roller.why: The shoulders hold the position but are not what this trains, and the source does not say which part.

Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.why: Pressing or pushing forward or overhead works the front delts.

Back_Flyes_-_With_Bands.why: Pulling the arms back works the rear delts.

Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.why: Pressing or pushing forward or overhead works the front delts.

Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.why: Pressing or pushing forward or overhead works the front delts. The incline aims the work at the upper chest.

Bench_Dips.why: Dips push the body up with the hands behind, which loads the front delts.

Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.why: Rowing and pulling down bring the upper arm back, which the rear delts help with.
